scope: Single saved-array algebraic check of the same fixed seed with forward terminal transfer replacing net I in the proposed rate; not a trap-capture model.
identity: Iplus=I/[1-exp(-v/VT)] for v>0, equal-temperature reservoirs, same elastic transmission kernel; Iminus=Iplus*exp(-v/VT).

seed.selection: Exactly two saved cycle4return2/4 inverse points, analytic zero-affinity alignment; no rounding or adaptive seed selection
seed.interpretation: Two-point conditional algebraic calibration, not independent prediction, optimization, or measured activation barrier

cases: Exactly original two grids x two material envelopes
prefix: Start at same .2V; stop at first upper>=0 or nonfinite. Never extend past originally saved certified prefix.
scoring: Use intersection of new prefix and saved native certified mask; reuse saved current ceilings and original500 denominator; all other errors zero.
no_recalibration: Keep lambda/J exactly fixed; this isolates one proposed flux correction. The two old return zero-affinity calibrations are not silently reimposed.
budget_start: After input loads, hashes and plan write; before four-case arithmetic.
stop_policy: One attempt only; preserve failures; no new temperature, seed, rate or table evaluation.
caveat: Forward terminal transfer is not reservoir incident population or local defect capture.
